item.title: People Power Party Ethics Committee Meeting Today... Expected to Decide on 'Disciplinary Action' (오늘 국민의힘 윤리위 회의...‘징계 개시’ 결정할 전망)
item.description:
People Power Party Ethics Committee Meeting Today... Expected to Decide on 'Disciplinary Action' (오늘 국민의힘 윤리위 회의...‘징계 개시’ 결정할 전망)

The Central Ethics Committee of the People Power Party will hold a plenary meeting on the morning of the 22nd to review disciplinary motions filed against incumbent lawmakers and others around the time of the June 3 local elections. Inside and outside the party, there are observations that the meeting may result in a vote to "initiate disciplinary proceedings" against some lawmakers. This involves screening individuals mentioned in the disciplinary requests to determine who actually requires a review of disciplinary action and proceeding with subsequent steps. (국민의힘 중앙윤리위원회는 22일 오전 전체회의를 열고 6·3 지방선거 전후로 접수된 현역 국회의원 등에 대한 징계안을 심의할 계획이다. 당 안팎에선 이날 회의에서 일부 의원에 대한 ‘징계 개시’ 의결이 이뤄질 가능성이 있다는 관측이 나온다. 징계 요청안에 거론된 인사 중 실제로 징계 여부를 검토해야 할 대상을 추리고, 후속 절차를 이어간다는 것이다.)

The Ethics Committee previously held its first meeting after the local elections on the 6th to examine over 60 disciplinary requests submitted by non-member committee chairs and party members. A People Power Party official stated, "At that time, we worked to verify which individuals and on what grounds the disciplinary requests were filed." (윤리위는 앞서 지난 6일 지방선거 이후 첫 회의를 열어 원외위원장, 당원 등이 낸 징계 요청안 60여 건을 들여다봤다. 국민의힘 관계자는 “당시 어떤 인물에 대해 어떤 사유로 징계 요청이 들어왔는지 확인하는 작업을 진행했다”고 했다.)

Among those mentioned as disciplinary targets is six-term lawmaker Cho Kyung-tae. Cho lost to fellow party lawmaker Park Deok-heum in a primary election for the National Assembly's vice-speaker position allocated to the opposition party. Subsequently, he is suspected of making "phone calls requesting Park Deok-heum's defeat" to Democratic Party lawmakers during the assembly's plenary vote for the position. Additionally, lawmakers from the pro-Han faction, who allegedly supported independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon's campaign in the Busan Buk-gu by-election, are also under review for disciplinary action. (징계 대상자로는 6선의 조경태 의원 등이 거론된다. 조 의원은 야당 몫 국회부의장을 선출하는 당내 경선에서 같은 당 박덕흠 의원에게 패했는데, 이후 국회 본회의 선출 과정에서 더불어민주당 의원들에게 ‘박덕흠 낙선 요청 전화’를 돌렸다는 의혹을 받고 있다. 또 무소속 한동훈 의원의 부산 북갑 보궐선거를 도왔다는 친한계 의원들도 징계 검토 대상에 올라 있다.)

The Ethics Committee is known to have set a policy of strictly adhering to legal procedures, referencing past cases where courts accepted injunctions to suspend disciplinary decisions. (윤리위는 과거 징계 결정에 대해 법원이 ‘효력 정지’ 가처분 신청을 받아들인 사례를 참고해, 법적 절차를 완벽히 준수하겠다는 방침으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok Targets Yoo Si-min: “There’s No ‘Rotten Stench’ in a Comrade’s Language… False Prophecies of Defeat Will Fail” (김민석, 유시민 겨냥 “동지의 언어에 ‘썩은내’ 없다… 헛예언 필패할 것”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok Targets Yoo Si-min: “There’s No ‘Rotten Stench’ in a Comrade’s Language… False Prophecies of Defeat Will Fail” (김민석, 유시민 겨냥 “동지의 언어에 ‘썩은내’ 없다… 헛예언 필패할 것”)

Kim Min-seok, a former prime minister and a pro-Lee Jae-myung candidate in the Democratic Party of Korea’s leadership election, pushed back on the 22nd against remarks made by Yoo Si-min, who had criticized the Lee Jae-myung administration with phrases like “an inevitable path to failure” and “the rotten stench of a fish market,” saying, “The false prophecies predicting the inevitable defeat of the Lee Jae-myung government will fail this time as well.” (더불어민주당 당대표 선거에 출마한 친이재명계 김민석 전 국무총리는 유시민씨가 이재명 정부를 공격하면서 한 “필연적인 실패의 길” “어물전 썩은내” 등의 발언에 대해 22일 “이재명 정부의 필패를 예언하는 헛예언들은 이번에도 필패할 것”이라며 반발했다.)

In a post on X (formerly Twitter) early that morning, Kim said, “In the language of comrades and from the perspective of affection, there are no words like ‘inevitable defeat’ or ‘rotten stench.’” (김 전 총리는 이날 새벽 X(옛 트위터)에 글을 올려 “동지의 언어, 애정의 시각에 ‘필패’ ‘썩은내’라는 단어는 없다”며 이같이 말했다.)

Regarding Yoo’s comments, Kim stated, “A politics that distorts and alters the president’s own words and true intentions, crossing the line of commentary, has lost its restraint and dignity.” He added, “Looking broadly, it’s just another intellectual’s pivot, like Kim Ji-ha, Jo Sun, or Lee Nak-yon.” (김 전 총리는 유씨의 발언에 대해 “대통령의 육성과 진심을 왜곡·변조하며 평론의 선을 월경한 정치는 절제와 품격조차 놓았다”며 “크게 보면 김지하처럼, 조순처럼, 이낙연처럼 또 하나의 지식인 변침일 뿐”이라고 했다.)

He continued, “(These false prophecies) will fail, just like their bogus predictions that Kim Dae-jung would fail,” and added, “All other hollow shells will go the same way (as Yoo).” (이어 “(헛예언들은) 김대중이 실패하리라던 그들의 엉터리 예언처럼 (필패할 것)”이라며 “다른 모든 껍데기들도 (유씨처럼) 갈 것”이라고 했다.)

Kim asserted, “The Democratic Party will prevail on both fronts—internal and external,” and claimed, “The essence of the battle lines, both inside and outside, is the same.” He vowed, “We will overcome anti-Lee factions, divisive forces, Shincheonji, and their alliances. We will protect the president, the party, the government, and national agendas, and desperately save everyone from Honam to Yeongnam.” (김 전 총리는 “민주당은 당 안팎에 조성된 두 개의 전선 모두에서 승리할 것”이라며 “안도 밖도 전선의 본질은 같다”고 주장했다. 그는 “반명도 분열주의도 신천지도 그 합작도 다 이겨내고, 대통령과 당과 정부와 국정 과제를 지켜내고 호남부터 영남까지 필사적으로 다 살릴 것”이라고 다짐했다.)

Kim also indicated, “I will treat the aggressiveness of a return to politics stripped of commentary robes as a ‘different political view’ from the Democratic Party and respect it,” effectively signaling he wouldn’t consider Yoo a fellow Democrat. (김 전 총리는 또 “평론의 옷을 벗은 정계 회귀의 공격성을 ‘민주당과 다른 정치적 견해’로 대우하고 존중하겠다”며, 사실상 유씨를 같은 민주당 사람으로 취급하지 않겠다는 뜻을 밝혔다.)

In this regard, he said, “If (Yoo’s remarks) serve as a backdrop for the Rebuilding Korea Party to strengthen its independent line, I will take that into account as well.” He added, “The Democratic Party will reorganize itself as a true Democratic Party, replace its leadership, and walk the great path befitting a center for solidarity, integration, and expansion.” (이와 관련해 그는 “(유씨의 발언이) 조국혁신당 독자 노선 강화의 배경이 된다면 그 또한 감안할 것”이라며 “민주당은 민주당답게 당을 정비하고 지도력을 교체하고, 연대·통합·확장의 중심다운 대도(大道)를 가겠다”고 했다.)

He continued, “The Democratic Party will clean up dual party affiliations (between the Democratic Party and the Rebuilding Korea Party) and eliminate suspicions of ghost members.” He added, “I also propose this to other parties. I recommend self-driven cleanup. It will benefit the Democratic Party, other parties, Korean politics, sound religion, and democracy.” (이어 “민주당은 (민주당·조국혁신당) 이중 당적을 정리하고 유령 당원 의혹을 일소하게 될 것”이라며 “다른 당들에도 제안한다. 자율적 정리도 권한다. 민주당에도, 다른 당에도, 한국 정치에도, 건전한 종교에도, 민주주의에도 도움이 될 것”이라고 했다.)

Kim concluded, “With a sense of responsibility that doesn’t shy away from the mud, I will continue to pioneer the future of the party, the government, and the nation. In the end, the Lee Jae-myung government and the Democratic Party will prevail.” (김 전 총리는 “진흙탕을 마다 않는 책임감으로 지금까지처럼 당과 정부, 국가의 장래를 개척해 가겠다”며 “결국 이재명 정부와 민주당이 승리할 것”이라고 했다.)

Yoo had appeared on the YouTube channel ‘2 Minute News’ the previous night, claiming, “The president holds a stance opposing the complete separation of investigation and prosecution, and has been working to push that through all along,” adding, “That would make this government a doomed one.” Regarding the pro-Lee faction’s backlash to his criticism of the Lee Jae-myung government, he said, “No matter how high-quality the fish sold at a fish market, it’s bound to smell fishy. If you leave it without any criticism or restrictions, any fish market is bound to reek of rot.” Concerning the president’s support base, ‘New Lee Jae-myung,’ he alleged, “Every action they take isn’t a riot by self-proclaimed pro-Lee supporters, but something planned and initiated right after taking office by the president and some aides we don’t know well.” (유씨는 전날 밤 유튜브 채널 ‘2분뉴스’에 출연해 “대통령이 수사·기소의 완전한 분리를 반대하는 입장을 갖고 있고, 이를 관철하려고 지금까지 노력해 온 것”이라고 주장하면서 “그러면 이 정부는 망하는 정부”라고 했다. 또 자신의 이재명 정부 비판에 친명계가 반발하는 데 대해서는 “아무리 품질 좋은 생선을 갖다 파는 어물전도 비린내는 나기 마련”이라며 “그걸 어떤 비판도 가하지 않고 어떤 제한도 두지 않고 내버려두면 모든 어물전은 다 썩은내를 풍기게 돼 있다”고 했다. 이 대통령 지지층인 ‘뉴이재명’과 관련해서는 “그들이 하는 모든 행동은 자칭 친명들이 벌이는 난동이 아니고, 집권 직후부터 대통령과 우리가 잘 알지 못하는 어떤 참모들이 기획해서 시작한 것”이라고 주장했다.)

item.title: Chung Cheong-rae: "Party Convention is Simple… Whether to Pursue Prosecution Reform, Whether to Preserve or Discard the One-Person-One-Vote System" (정청래 “전당대회 심플… 검찰개혁 하냐 마냐, 1인 1표제 사수냐 파기냐”)
item.description:
Chung Cheong-rae: "Party Convention is Simple… Whether to Pursue Prosecution Reform, Whether to Preserve or Discard the One-Person-One-Vote System" (정청래 “전당대회 심플… 검찰개혁 하냐 마냐, 1인 1표제 사수냐 파기냐”)

Chung Cheong-rae, a former representative who is running for party leader in the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 convention, on the 22nd defined the meaning of the convention as a choice over so-called "prosecution reform," the one-person-one-vote system, and whether to pursue party unity or not. (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거에 출마한 정청래 전 대표가 22일 전당대회의 의미를 이른바 “검찰 개혁”과 1인 1표제, 당 통합을 할 것이냐 말 것이냐로 규정했다.)

In a Facebook post that morning, former Representative Chung stated, "The August 17 convention is simple," adding, "1. Will we pursue prosecution reform or not? 2. Will we preserve or discard the one-person-one-vote system? 3. From the perspective of continuing the legacy of Presidents Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, Moon Jae-in, and Lee Jae-myung, will it be unity or division?" (정 전 대표는 이날 오전 페이스북에 글을 올려 “8·17 전대는 심플하다(단순하다)”며 “1. 검찰 개혁 하느냐? 마느냐? 2. 1인 1표제 사수냐? 파기냐? 3. 김대중, 노무현, 문재인, 이재명 대통령의 역사 계승의 관점에서 통합이냐? 분열이냐?”라고 했다.)

Former Representative Chung argues that completely abolishing the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers constitutes prosecution reform and insists this must be accomplished before the convention. Additionally, he introduced the one-person-one-vote system during his tenure as party leader, eliminating the disparity in voting weight between delegates and dues-paying party members in internal party elections, and highlights this as one of his achievements. (정 전 대표는 검찰 보완수사권 완전 폐지가 검찰 개혁이라며 전당대회 전까지 이를 완수해야 한다고 주장하고 있다. 또 앞서 당대표 시절 당내 선거에서 대의원과 권리당원 표 비중의 차이를 없애는 1인 1표제를 도입했고, 이를 자신의 업적으로 내세우고 있다.)

Former Representative Chung’s mention of "unity or division" is interpreted as a remark considering that other party leadership candidates have labeled him as an anti-Lee Jae-myung candidate and even raised allegations of "Shincheonji involvement." Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok told reporters the previous day, "Breaking the triple alliance of anti-Lee, divisiveness, and Shincheonji is the essence of this convention." (정 전 대표가 ‘통합이냐, 분열이냐’고 한 것은 다른 당대표 후보들이 정 전 대표를 반이재명 후보로 규정하고 ‘신천지 개입설’까지 제기하는 것을 염두에 둔 발언으로 풀이된다. 김민석 전 국무총리는 전날 기자들과 만나 “반명·분열주의·신천지의 삼자 연합을 깨는 것이 이번 전당대회의 본질”이라고 했다.)

In response, former Representative Chung wrote, "Let's move beyond divisive conspiracy theories toward unity and reform." (이와 관련해 정 전 대표는 “분열주의적 음모론을 넘어 통합과 개혁으로 가자”고 썼다.)

item.title: Despite botched investigation into 'Jang Yun-gi case'... Ruling party pushes for complete abolition of supplementary investigation rights (‘장윤기 사건’ 부실수사에도… 與, 보완수사권 완전 폐지 강행)
item.description:
Despite botched investigation into 'Jang Yun-gi case'... Ruling party pushes for complete abolition of supplementary investigation rights (‘장윤기 사건’ 부실수사에도… 與, 보완수사권 완전 폐지 강행)

Han Byeong-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 22nd, "If we compromise while leaving even the slightest loophole, the essence of prosecutorial power will remain," effectively announcing the party's policy to completely abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights. <<> Acting leader Han argued at a party supreme council meeting held at the National Assembly that morning, "The principle that prosecutors do not conduct investigations is both the starting point and the completion of prosecutorial reform that separates investigation from prosecution," adding, "There is no dissenting opinion within the party on this fundamental principle." <<> Acting leader Han further stated, "Minor differences in perception should not be allowed to undermine the principle of separating investigation from prosecution or become a tool to restore the prosecution's investigative powers." <<> Regarding the criticism that the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights are necessary to protect crime victims, he said, "That is precisely why we cannot entrust victim protection to the goodwill or discretion of a specific agency. We must create a system where anyone receives equal and robust protection from the state, rather than a system where the fate of a case changes depending on which prosecutor handles it." He added, "The claim that victims can only be protected if prosecutors investigate directly is not true when we look back at the prosecution's dark past." <<> Acting leader Han stated, "The Democratic Party will substantiate the right to request supplementary investigations and clearly assign responsibilities so that investigative agencies fulfill those requests promptly and faithfully." This means completely abolishing the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights while strengthening the system related to the right to request supplementary investigations to address any side effects. <<> Acting leader Han said, "The discussion has sufficiently matured. The time has come to unite the party's collective opinion," adding, "Reform always faces resistance. If even a small loophole remains, forces seeking to return to the past will activate. If we stop or compromise here, only the signboard of the Prosecution Service will change to the Public Prosecution Office, while the essence of prosecutorial power remains." <<> Acting leader Han declared, "We will no longer postpone this to the next administration or the next National Assembly," and added, "We will responsibly conclude the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act (to completely abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights)." <<> ◇Full text of the opening remarks by Han Byeong-do, Acting Leader and Floor Leader of the Democratic Party of Korea <<> Prosecutorial reform is not a slogan that emerged suddenly one day. It is a historical demand that Korean democracy has written with blood and tears. <<> The Democratic Party held a policy general meeting in the format of a public hearing yesterday regarding the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act. We gathered diverse opinions from various sectors and engaged in intense discussions. Meanwhile, the government, centered on the Prosecutorial Reform Task Force, has organized major issues, and the party has matured the discussion through the Criminal Procedure Act Amendment Task Force. In the meantime, the Legislation and Judiciary Committee has also held seven full committee meetings and bill subcommittee meetings, meticulously reviewing 22 issues one by one. <<> This entire process was not simply an adjustment of authority between the prosecution and the police. It was a historic process to rectify the criminal justice system, distorted around the prosecution for the past 70-plus years, and to return judicial sovereignty to the people. <<> During the military dictatorship era, the prosecution became a tool for maintaining the regime, suppressing democracy and human rights. Even after democratization, holding both investigative and indicting powers in one hand, they directly and indirectly intervened in politics through investigations, and at times acted as if they could even decide the nation's fate. They turned a blind eye to the illegality of those in power, while trying to fabricate crimes against the opposition. Through selective investigations, targeted investigations, investigations for other charges, and the public disclosure of suspected facts, they destroyed the lives and reputations of individuals without ever being properly held accountable. <<> We deeply engrave the tragedy of failing to protect President Roh Moo-hyun. We can never forget the profound grief of being unable to do anything in the face of the outrageous investigation and media manipulation that drove a person's life to the brink. <<> Power that is not checked is inevitably abused. If we maintain a structure where the investigator also decides whether to indict, a structure where the creator of a case brings it to the judgment seat, the history of political prosecutors can be repeated at any time. <<> The Democratic Party has abolished the Prosecution Service and established the Public Prosecution Office and the Serious Crimes Investigation Office. Now, through the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act, we must change not just the signboard but also the actual authority and operational methods. <<> The Democratic Party's principle has been consistent from the start. Investigative agencies should handle investigations, while the Public Prosecution Office should handle indictments and maintaining public prosecutions. Prosecutors do not investigate. This is both the starting point and the completion of prosecutorial reform that separates investigation from prosecution. <<> There is no dissenting opinion within the party on this fundamental principle. There are only intense discussions on creating a better system, such as the methods of mutual checks and cooperation between investigative agencies and measures for victim protection. <<> However, minor differences in perception should not shake the principle of separating investigation from prosecution or become a means to restore the prosecution's investigative powers. <<> We have also listened attentively to the argument that supplementary investigation rights are necessary for victim protection. We deeply empathize with the urgent voices that not a single victim in cases targeting the socially vulnerable, such as sexual violence, child abuse, and crimes against the disabled, should be left in the gaps of the system. <<> That is precisely why we cannot entrust victim protection to the goodwill or discretion of a specific agency. We must create a system where anyone receives equal and robust protection from the state, rather than a system where the fate of a case changes depending on which prosecutor handles it. <<> The claim that victims can only be protected if prosecutors investigate directly is not true when we look back at the prosecution's dark history. There are countless cases the prosecution ignored, downplayed, or covered up the truth. <<> What protects citizens' rights is not an all-powerful authority but a meticulously designed system. The Democratic Party will substantiate the right to request supplementary investigations and clearly specify responsibilities so that investigative agencies fulfill these requests promptly and faithfully. We will ensure that there are effective accountability measures for investigation delays, such as replacing investigators and demanding disciplinary action for poor investigations. We will establish a cross-investigation system where the police and the Serious Crimes Investigation Office check each other, and strengthen investigation reviews and external inspections. We will also more robustly guarantee victims' rights to file objections, access records, and receive legal assistance. We will establish control and cooperation mechanisms suitable for the new criminal justice system. While clearly separating investigation and prosecution, we will fully maintain national investigative capabilities and protect crime victims more strongly than now. <<> The discussion has sufficiently matured. The time has come to unite the party's collective opinion. <<> Reform always faces resistance. Even a small remaining loophole enables forces seeking to return to the past. If we stop or compromise here, only the signboard of the Prosecution Service will change to the Public Prosecution Office, while the essence of prosecutorial power remains. <<> If we fail to complete prosecutorial reform this time as well, the dark history of political prosecutors will repeat itself again. If the people later ask why we didn't do it when we had the chance, what answer could we give? <<> We will no longer postpone this to the next administration or the next National Assembly. We will not pass on the failures and tragedies of the past to future generations. We will surely establish a criminal justice system where the people are the masters. We will uphold our principles unwaveringly while making the system more sophisticated. Using the rights and interests of the people and the human rights of victims as our benchmarks, we will responsibly conclude the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act. The Democratic Party will get it done. We will complete prosecutorial reform this time without fail. <<> (더불어민주당 한병도 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 22일 “작은 빈틈이라도 남기고 타협한다면 검찰 권력의 본질은 그대로 남는다”며 검찰 보완수사권을 완전히 폐지하겠다는 방침을 사실상 밝혔다.)

item.title: Yoo Si-min: "The head of 'New Lee Jae-myung' is President Lee… If left alone, it will reek like a rotten fish market" (유시민 “뉴이재명 수장은 李대통령… 내버려두면 어물전 썩은내”)
item.description:
Yoo Si-min: "The head of 'New Lee Jae-myung' is President Lee… If left alone, it will reek like a rotten fish market" (유시민 “뉴이재명 수장은 李대통령… 내버려두면 어물전 썩은내”)

Yoo Si-min, who faced harsh criticism from the pro-Lee Jae-myung faction for remarks such as "President Lee Jae-myung is heading down an inevitable path to failure," argued, "'New Lee Jae-myung' — all their actions are not a riot staged by self-proclaimed pro-Lee supporters, but something planned and initiated by the President and certain advisors we don't know well, right after taking office." (“이재명 대통령이 필연적인 실패의 길로 가고 있다” 등의 발언으로 친이재명계의 거센 비판을 받은 유시민씨가 “‘뉴이재명’, 그들이 하는 모든 행동은 자칭 친명들이 벌이는 난동이 아니고, 집권 직후부터 대통령과 우리가 잘 알지 못하는 어떤 참모들이 기획해서 시작한 것”이라고 주장했다.)

Appearing on the YouTube channel '2-Minute News' on the night of the 21st, Yoo said, "We've reached a point where we must judge it that way." (유씨는 지난 21일 밤 유튜브 채널 ‘2분뉴스’에 출연해 “그렇게 판단해야만 하는 시점에 왔다”며 이같이 말했다.)

New Lee Jae-myung refers to a faction within the Democratic Party that supports President Lee's expansion of outreach and the so-called 'pragmatic' line. They have clashed with traditional pro-Roh and pro-Moon supporters over issues like the push for a merger with the Fatherland Innovation Party and the complete abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers. Yoo had previously attacked New Lee Jae-myung through his so-called 'ABC theory,' claiming they "flowed in pursuing self-interest." (뉴이재명은 민주당 내에서 이 대통령의 외연 확장과 이른바 ‘실용주의’ 노선을 지지하는 당원층을 말하는 것으로, 전통적인 친노·친문 지지층과는 조국혁신당과의 합당 추진, 검찰 보완수사권 완전 폐지 등을 두고 대립해 왔다. 유씨는 앞서 이른바 ‘ABC론’을 통해서 뉴이재명에 대해 “이익을 좇아 유입됐다”며 공격해 왔다.)

Yoo also stated, "I judged that the head of the New Lee Jae-myung faction is not someone like Lee Eon-ju, but is highly likely to be President Lee himself." (유씨는 그러면서 “뉴이재명 세력의 수장은 이언주나 이런 사람이 아니고, 이 대통령일 가능성이 높다고 저는 판단했다”며 이같이 말했다.)

Yoo further claimed, "I believe the President holds a stance opposing the complete separation of investigation and prosecution, and has been working to push this through up to now." He argued, "Beyond the hypothesis that 'the President wants to keep investigative powers with the prosecution,' is there any other hypothesis that can consistently explain all government actions regarding prosecution reform since September of last year?" (유씨는 또 “대통령이 수사·기소의 완전한 분리를 반대하는 입장을 갖고 있고, 이를 관철하려고 지금까지 노력해온 것이라고 생각한다”며 “‘대통령이 검찰에 수사권을 남겨놓고 싶어 한다’는 가설 외에 작년 9월 이후 지금까지 검찰 개혁과 관련해 벌어진 정부의 모든 행위를 일관되게 설명할 수 있는 어떤 가설이 있을 수 있느냐”고 주장했다.)

Yoo also criticized the government for not simultaneously pushing for the enactment of laws to establish a Major Crimes Investigation Office and a Public Prosecution Office, along with amendments to the Criminal Procedure Act, regarding the complete abolition of prosecution investigative powers. Yoo said, "The Prime Minister's Office task force (Prosecution Reform Promotion Team) released odd poll results, dragged things out in absolutely unacceptable ways, said they'd handle the Criminal Procedure Act after the local elections, then ended the task force's activities, saying 'There's no government plan; we'll leave it to the National Assembly,' and then self-proclaimed pro-Lee lawmakers proposed strange legislation (partially maintaining supplementary investigation powers)." He added, "It's time to see this as the President's judgment. How could all this happen against his will?" (유씨는 정부가 검찰 수사권 완전 폐지와 관련해 중수청·공소청 설치법 제정과 형사소송법 개정을 한꺼번에 추진하지 않은 것도 문제라고 주장했다. 유씨는 “총리실 TF(검찰개혁추진단)는 이상한 여론조사 결과 내놓고, 도저히 납득할 수 없는 상황에서 시간을 끌었고, 형소법은 뭐 지방선거 끝나고 한다 해놓고 이제 TF 활동 종료하면서 ‘정부안이 없다. 국회에 맡기겠다’ 그래놓고, 소위 친명을 자처하는 의원들이 이상한 (보완수사권 일부 유지) 입법안을 낸다”며 “이것은 대통령의 판단이라고 봐야 할 때가 왔다. 어떻게 대통령의 의사에 반해서 이 모든 일이 일어날 수 있겠느냐”고 했다.)

Yoo said, "Then this government is a doomed government." (유씨는 “그러면 이 정부는 망하는 정부”라고 했다.)

Regarding the backlash from the pro-Lee faction over his criticism of the Lee Jae-myung government, Yoo said, "No matter how good the quality of fish a market sells, it's bound to smell fishy. If you leave it without any criticism or restrictions, every fish market will eventually give off a rotten smell." He added, "Someone with a keen sense of smell needs to speak up." (유씨는 한편 자신의 이재명 정부 비판에 친명계가 반발하는 상황과 관련해 “아무리 품질 좋은 생선을 갖다 파는 어물전도 비린내는 나기 마련”이라며 “그걸 어떤 비판도 가하지 않고 어떤 제한도 두지 않고 내버려두면 모든 어물전은 다 썩은내를 풍기게 돼 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “후각이 예민한 사람이 말을 해야 한다”고 했다.)

Yoo also said, "When someone says, 'The fishy smell is a bit off,' and it starts with 'You bastard, you're damaging our fish market's reputation,' then goes to 'What do you take me for?,' and ends up driving them out so no one can say a word, then the rotten smell comes out." (유씨는 “누가 ‘생선 비린내가 약간 이상한데’ 할 때 ‘너 이 새끼, 우리 어물전 명예를 훼손하고 있어’부터 시작해 가지고 ‘너, 나를 뭘로 보는 거야?’ 이렇게 하기 시작해서 쫓아내버리고 아무도 그 말을 못하게 되면 썩은내가 나는 것”이라고도 했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Military report on ‘merging service academies’ shows 49.1% public support … Survey conducted after presenting phrase emphasizing ‘jointness’ ([단독] 軍 ‘사관학교 통합 추진’ 보고서엔 ‘통합 찬성’ 국민 49.1% … ‘합동성 강조’ 문구 제시한 뒤 설문)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Military report on ‘merging service academies’ shows 49.1% public support … Survey conducted after presenting phrase emphasizing ‘jointness’ ([단독] 軍 ‘사관학교 통합 추진’ 보고서엔 ‘통합 찬성’ 국민 49.1% … ‘합동성 강조’ 문구 제시한 뒤 설문)

It was learned on the 22nd that the military included results from its own survey showing 49.1% of the general public supporting the merger of the Army, Navy, and Air Force service academies in a research report on promoting such integration. However, it is reported that the survey may be controversial for its fairness, as respondents were provided beforehand with a phrase stating that "transcending the boundaries between the Army, Navy, and Air Force is important." (군이 육·해·공군 사관학교 통합 추진을 위한 용역 보고서에 일반 국민의 49.1%가 통합을 찬성한다는 자체 설문조사 결과를 포함시킨 것으로 22일 알려졌다. 그런데 설문 대상자에게 “육·해·공군의 경계를 넘는 게 중요하다”는 문구를 사전에 제시해 설문의 공정성에 대한 논란의 여지가 있는 것으로 전해졌다.)

According to this newspaper’s coverage on the same day, the Korea Institute for Defense Analyses (KIDA), under the Ministry of National Defense, cited in its April research report titled ‘Study on the Promotion Plan for Merging Service Academies’ the results of its own survey, which showed that 49.1% of the general public supported the merger of the three branches’ service academies. Opposition to the merger stood at 21%. Based on this, the report stated, “The justification for maintaining the current separate system of service academies is gradually weakening outside the military,” and added, “It can be judged that the minimum foundation for promoting the policy has been established.” The report noted that the survey was conducted between January and February. <<> This contrasts with recent opinion poll results. According to a regular survey by polling agencies Embrain Public, K-Stat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research on the 16th, titled the ‘National Indicator Survey (NBS),’ 55% of the general public opposed the merger of service academies, citing that “the expertise and specificity of each branch would be weakened.” Support stood at 34%. In a separate poll released by the Reform Party on the same day, opposition was at 75.4%, with support at 22.5%. <<> The report, however, stated that before asking respondents their views on supporting or opposing the merger, it provided them with “information related to changes in the future battlefield environment.” This ‘information’ was a phrase emphasizing military jointness. It included content such as, “The modern battlefield is evolving into a complex form combining AI and space technology,” and “To respond to these changes, it is becoming increasingly important for the Army, Navy, and Air Force to possess joint operational capabilities that move beyond boundaries and act as one.” The result of the survey conducted afterward was that 49.1% of the general public supported the merger. <<> Experts point out that such survey practices can lead to debates over bias. Bae Jong-chan, head of the Insight K Research Institute and a polling expert, said, “If a survey includes explanations that can influence respondents’ perceptions, they will make judgments based on that influence,” and added, “This survey appears to have had a kind of ‘priming effect’ emphasizing ‘military integration’ through the phrasing provided beforehand.” There are also criticisms that the research report essentially pre-determined its conclusion and designed the survey to support it. <<> Some survey results did not align with the ‘promotion of merger’ direction. When respondents were asked for their opinions on the “current operational method of separate Army, Navy, and Air Force service academies,” 57.2% of the general public answered that it was ‘efficient.’ Only 12.5% said it was ‘inefficient.’ The majority opinion was that the current state of having separate three-branch service academies is efficient. <<> However, the report attributed these results to a possible “status quo bias,” suggesting that responses might have been “habitual answers from individuals who had never considered alternatives.” This effectively downplayed the significance of the finding. <<> Meanwhile, according to the report, 91.3% of current cadets at the three service academies opposed the merger in the survey. Among active-duty officers, 60.9% opposed it. Within the active-duty officer group, opposition from Army Academy graduates was highest at 84.1%, and even in the group categorized as ‘ROTC, officer candidate school, and other’ backgrounds, opposition exceeded half at 55.5%. <<> The report commented on this, saying, “Though cadets have limited military experience and fewer opportunities to grasp the necessity of merging service academies, the high opposition rate can be interpreted as a response based on institutional identity. The key is how to reduce internal military opposition to merging the service academies.” It added, “A process that sufficiently gathers opinions from experts in each branch’s service academies and related fields must be supported.” (이날 본지 취재에 따르면, 국방부 산하 한국국방연구원(KIDA)이 지난 4월 작성한 ‘사관학교 통합 추진 방안 연구’ 용역 보고서는 일반 국민의 49.1%가 3군 사관학교 통합을 찬성한다는 자체 설문조사 결과를 인용했다. 통합 반대는 21%였다. 보고서는 이를 근거로 “현 사관학교 병립 체제 유지의 정당성 자체가 군 외부에서는 서서히 약화됐다”며 “정책 추진의 최소한 기반은 형성된 것으로 판단할 수 있다”고 했다. 이 설문은 지난 1~2월 이뤄졌다고 보고서는 밝혔다.)

item.title: 55.3% Oppose Abolition of Complementary Investigation Authority, 27.4% in Favor (보완수사권 폐지 ‘반대’ 55.3%, ‘찬성’ 27.4%)
item.description:
55.3% Oppose Abolition of Complementary Investigation Authority, 27.4% in Favor (보완수사권 폐지 ‘반대’ 55.3%, ‘찬성’ 27.4%)

A poll has found that over 55% of respondents oppose the abolition of the prosecution's complementary investigation authority, which is being pursued by the ruling Democratic Party of Korea and other parties. Approval ratings for President Lee Jae-myung's administration dropped by 5.9 percentage points to 48.8% compared to the previous survey. (더불어민주당 등 여권이 추진 중인 검찰 보완수사권 폐지와 관련해 반대 의견이 55% 이상이라는 여론조사 결과가 나왔다. 이재명 대통령의 국정운영에 대한 긍정 평가는 지난 조사 대비 5.9%포인트 하락한 48.8%로 집계됐다.)

According to a survey conducted by the Korea Society Opinion Institute (KSOI) on the 20th and 21st of this month, targeting 1,000 adults aged 18 and over nationwide, 55.3% of respondents were 'opposed' to the abolition of the complementary investigation authority, while 27.4% were 'in favor'. The 'undecided' rate stood at 17.3%. (한국사회여론연구소(KSOI)가 지난 20~21일 전국 만 18세 이상 1000명을 대상으로 조사한 결과, 보완수사권 폐지에 대한 ‘반대’ 의견이 55.3%로 ‘찬성’ 27.4%를 앞섰다. ‘잘 모름’은 17.3%로 집계됐다.)

In a poll on suitability for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, former leader Chung Cheong-rae recorded 25.7%. This was followed by former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok at 21.5%, former leader Song Young-gil at 8.3%, lawmaker Go Min-jung at 3.9%, and former Gangjin County Council chairperson Kim Bo-mi at 2.6%. (더불어민주당 당대표 적합도 조사에선 정청래 전 대표가 25.7%를 기록했다. 이어 김민석 전 국무총리가 21.5%, 송영길 전 대표 8.3%, 고민정 의원 3.9%, 김보미 전 강진군의회 의장 2.6% 순이었다.)

President Lee's approval rating for state management was 48.8%, while disapproval stood at 46.7%. Compared to the previous survey (two weeks ago), approval dropped by 5.9 percentage points, and disapproval rose by 5.8 percentage points. (이 대통령의 국정운영에 대한 긍정 평가는 48.8%, 부정 평가는 46.7%로 나타났다. 지난 조사(2주 전)에 비해 긍정 평가는 5.9%포인트 떨어졌고, 부정 평가는 5.8%포인트 올랐다.)

Party support ratings showed the Democratic Party at 42.9% and the People Power Party at 30.6%. The Democratic Party's support fell by 2.1 percentage points, while the People Power Party's support rose by 1.5 percentage points. The Reform Party followed with 3.3%, the Fatherland Innovation Party with 1.9%, and the Progressive Party with 1.2%. (정당 지지도는 민주당이 42.9%, 국민의힘 30.6%로 집계됐다. 민주당 지지도는 2.1%포인트 떨어졌고 국민의힘 지지도는 1.5%포인트 올랐다. 개혁신당이 3.3%, 조국혁신당 1.9%, 진보당 1.2%로 뒤를 이었다.)

Regarding the integration of the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies, 50.6% opposed, 32.8% supported, and 16.6% were undecided. (육·해·공군 사관학교 통합에 관해서는 반대가 50.6%, 찬성 32.8%, 잘 모름 16.6%로 조사됐다.)

This survey was conducted via automated response system (ARS). The margin of error is ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. For more details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. (이번 조사는 자동응답(ARS) 조사로 진행됐다. 표본오차는 95% 신뢰수준에서 ±3.1%p다. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지를 참조하면 된다.)

item.title: Discussions on Party Reform Centered on Party Members: "The Imperial Party Leader System Must Be Reformed" (野 당원 중심 정당 개혁 논의 “제왕적 당대표제 바꿔야”)
item.description:
Discussions on Party Reform Centered on Party Members: "The Imperial Party Leader System Must Be Reformed" (野 당원 중심 정당 개혁 논의 “제왕적 당대표제 바꿔야”)

The "Alternatives and Future" group, a gathering of minor-faction first- and second-term lawmakers within the People Power Party, discussed party innovation measures on the 22nd and stated that "to win elections, we must move beyond a member-centered party and advance toward a national party." Additionally, at the meeting, proposals to reduce the powers of the party leader were discussed to mitigate the side effects of the imperial party leader system. (국민의힘 비주류 초·재선 중심 의원 모임인 ‘대안과미래’가 22일 정당 혁신 방안에 대해 논의하고 “선거 승리를 위해서 당원 중심 정당이 아닌 국민 정당으로 나아가야 한다”는 입장을 밝혔다. 이밖에 이날 모임에선 제왕적 당대표제의 부작용을 줄이기 위해 당대표 권한을 축소하는 안도 논의됐다.)

Alternatives and Future held a breakfast meeting at the National Assembly Members' Office Building that morning to discuss strategies for party innovation and conservative expansion aimed at securing victory for the conservative party. Attendees included the group's secretary, People Power Party lawmaker Lee Seong-kwon, along with fellow party members Ko Dong-jin, Kwon Young-jin, Kim Keon, Kim Sung-won, Park Jung-ha, Song Seok-jun, Ahn Sang-hoon, Woo Jae-jun, Yoo Yong-won, Jeong Yeon-wook, Cho Eun-hee, and Choi Hyung-du. <<> After the meeting, Secretary Lee Seong-kwon told reporters, "For the conservative party to win (in elections), it must not be overly focused on the ideology of conservatism but must transform beyond that into a national party." <<> Lee stated, "Limiting ourselves to a party run solely for its members makes it difficult to win elections." He added, "It's true that there were discussions (at today's meeting) about the problems with the party member structure—composed of fan bases and some hardcore supporters—in both the Democratic Party and the People Power Party. We will continue to address these issues as part of future party reform. While ensuring member participation, we plan to hold a public forum soon to explore directions for becoming an open national party that reflects public opinion." <<> At the breakfast meeting, measures to reform the imperial party leader system were also discussed. Lee said, "Looking at the history of Korean political parties, the party leader holds representativeness, but too much authority over party operations, personnel, and candidate nominations is concentrated in the leader, strengthening the imperial aspect and causing many side effects." He added, "Abolishing the party leader system itself is not easy, but we have agreed to continuously seek ways to reduce these side effects." <<> Specifically, discussions included separating the party leader's role from nomination rights and restructuring the imperial system centered on a single party leader into a co-leadership system. During this process, it was reportedly mentioned that the national convention should be reorganized as a supreme body to decide policies, platforms, and budgets, rather than being an event solely for electing the party leader. <<> At the meeting, lawmaker Choi Hyung-du served as the presenter. In his presentation, Choi highlighted the complete separation of nomination rights from the party leader's powers as a key task to reform the imperial party leader system, where all authority—including nomination and personnel powers—is concentrated in the party leader. <<> Choi proposed measures to reform the imperial party leader system, including: ▲full separation of nomination rights and party leader authority; ▲substantial restoration of local party structures (regional committees/district parties); ▲redesigning the party leader from a "power holder" to a "coordinator"; ▲transforming the party from an election machine into a "policy community"; and ▲ensuring deliberative member democracy and diversity. He particularly emphasized the need for a nomination system with transparency and objectivity, while aiming for a national party and generational coalition, along with talent cultivation. (대안과미래는 이날 오전 국회 의원회관에서 조찬 모임을 갖고 보수 정당이 승리하기 위한 정당 혁신 및 보수 확장 전략을 논의했다. 이 자리에는 모임 간사인 국민의힘 이성권 의원과 같은 당 소속 고동진·권영진·김건·김성원·박정하·송석준·안상훈·우재준·유용원·정연욱·조은희·최형두 의원 등이 참석했다.)

item.title: Lee Byung-tae: "The cause of the Baejae High School incident is the president... The arrogance of those in power stirred conflict" (이병태 “배재고 사태, 원인 제공자는 대통령...권력자 오만이 갈등 불러”)
item.description:
Lee Byung-tae: "The cause of the Baejae High School incident is the president... The arrogance of those in power stirred conflict" (이병태 “배재고 사태, 원인 제공자는 대통령...권력자 오만이 갈등 불러”)

Lee Byung-tae, former vice-chairman of the Regulatory Reform Committee, said on the 22nd, "The person who caused the Baejae High School incident is President Lee Jae-myung." (이병태 전 규제합리화위원회 부위원장은 22일 “배재고 사태의 원인 제공자는 이재명 대통령”이라고 했다.)

The former vice-chairman criticized the backlash against Baejae High School's baseball team's "Starbucks cheer song," stating, "The May 18 Gwangju Uprising has become a sanctuary," but when this criticism sparked controversy within the conservative circle, he resigned earlier this month from his position as vice-chairman of the presidential Regulatory Reform Committee. At the time, the presidential office publicly recommended his resignation. (이 전 위원장은 배재고 야구부의 ‘스타벅스 응원가’에 질타가 쏟아지는 상황에 대해 “5·18이 성역이 됐다”고 비판했다가, 이런 비판이 여권 내에서 논란이 되자 이달 초 대통령 직속 규제합리화위 부위원장직에서 사퇴했다. 당시 청와대가 공개적으로 사퇴를 권고했다.)

In a Facebook post that day, the former vice-chairman pointed to President Lee as the cause of the Starbucks Korea "Tank Day" marketing controversy and the subsequent Baejae High School baseball team's cheer song controversy. He said, "His irresponsible, conspiratorial perspective, posting thoughtless words late at night on social media, claiming that Starbucks Korea's marketing mocked the unfortunate events of the past democratization process, can be seen as the beginning and entirety of this issue." (이 전 위원장은 이날 페이스북에 올린 글에서 스타벅스코리아의 ‘탱크 데이’ 마케팅 논란, 그리고 이어진 배재고 야구부의 응원가 논란의 원인 제공자로 이 대통령을 지목했다. 이 전 위원장은 “그가 무책임한 음모론적 시각으로 SNS에 스타벅스코리아 마케팅을 과거 민주화 과정의 불행한 사건들을 조롱하는 것으로 한밤중에 생각 없는 글을 올린 것이 이 문제의 시작이자 전부로 볼 수 있다”고 했다.)

President Lee had posted on X (formerly Twitter), expressing anger over Starbucks Korea's "Tank Day" event on May 18, which used phrases like "on the desk," stating, "I am enraged by the inhumane and disgraceful behavior of these low-life merchants." In a live-streamed Cabinet meeting, he also said, "How can a person in human form do such a thing?" (이 대통령은 스타벅스코리아가 지난 5월 18일 ‘탱크 데이’ 이벤트를 진행하며 ‘책상에 탁’ 등의 문구를 사용한 데 대해 X(옛 트위터)에 올린 글에서 “저질 장사치의 비인간적 막장 행태에 분노한다”고 했었다. 생중계되는 국무회의에서는 “어떻게 사람의 탈을 쓰고 그럴 수 있나”라고도 했다.)

The former vice-chairman described this incident as "a case of national conflict caused by the arrogance of those in power, who appointed themselves as history judges." He added, "I conveyed to the senior presidential secretary for national unity that the president should apologize. I don't know if that message was delivered, but the one who caused this is still playing innocent." (이 전 부위원장은 이번 사건을 “권력자의 역사 심판관을 자처한 오만이 부른 국민 갈등의 사례”라고 했다. 그러면서 “나는 국민통합비서관에게 대통령이 사과해야 한다는 뜻을 전했다”며 “그 말이 전달되었는지 모르지만 원인 제공자는 지금까지 시치미를 떼고 있다”고 했다.)

The former vice-chairman also said, "Why did I argue that Gwangju has been sanctified? It's because people and powers trying to monopolize the political symbolism and meaning of history and specific events (like the Sewol ferry disaster) are using it as a marker or identifier for factional politics, stigmatizing and character-assassinating opponents." Sharing an interview with the media, he called for "the arrogant and irresponsible power to reflect." (이 전 부위원장은 “나는 광주가 왜 성역화되었다고 항변했는가”라며 “그것은 역사와 특정 사건(세월호)의 정치적 상징성과 의미를 독점하려는 사람들과 권력이 상대를 낙인찍고 인격살인하는 진영 정치의 표식(Marker, Identifier)으로 삼고 있기 때문”이라고도 했다. 이 전 부위원장은 자신의 언론 인터뷰를 공유하며 “오만하고 무책임한 권력의 반성을 촉구한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Board of Audit and Inspection: "Unsold Public Housing Units May Be Prioritized for Foreign-National Compatriots" (감사원 “공공주택 미분양분, 외국 국적 동포에게 우선 공급해도 된다”)
item.description:
Board of Audit and Inspection: "Unsold Public Housing Units May Be Prioritized for Foreign-National Compatriots" (감사원 “공공주택 미분양분, 외국 국적 동포에게 우선 공급해도 된다”)

The Board of Audit and Inspection (BAI) has issued an interpretation that if unsold units arise in newly built public rental housing, they can be prioritized for supply to foreign-national compatriots. <<> On the 22nd, the BAI announced its response to a preliminary consultation request from South Chungcheong Province regarding whether unsold units of public rental housing slated for sale conversion in the Nampo New Town area of Hongseong County and Yesan County could be prioritized for overseas compatriots. The BAI stated that "overseas compatriots can be selected as occupants." <<> The BAI's preliminary consultation system allows public institutions to inquire with the BAI in advance and receive responses when there are ambiguities in laws and regulations before carrying out administrative actions. This system reduces the burden on the relevant public institution of later being accused of violating laws by the BAI. <<> According to the BAI, South Chungcheong Province is promoting a project to attract overseas compatriots' reverse migration to domestic areas to address population decline and revitalize the local economy. The province recognized that resolving housing issues for overseas compatriots is essential to attract them and has been reviewing a plan to supply unsold units of public rental housing being built in Nampo New Town—which involves a six-year lease followed by conditional sale conversion—to overseas compatriots. However, due to the lack of clear regulations on whether domestic public rental housing can be prioritized for foreign-national overseas compatriots, the province had been unable to make a decision. <<> The BAI noted that under the Special Act on Public Housing, foreigners are generally not eligible for prioritized supply of public housing. However, the BAI focused on exceptions in the Enforcement Rules of the Special Act on Public Housing and the "Rules on Housing Supply," which allow project operators to select occupants on a first-come, first-served basis for remaining units after prioritizing those meeting occupancy requirements. <<> The BAI also considered that the housing units under review by South Chungcheong Province are being built by the Chungcheongnam-do Development Corporation using funds and other resources, with occupancy scheduled for 2027. Of the 949 units, 276 remain unsold. Supplying these to overseas compatriots could achieve outcomes aligned with the legislative intent of the Overseas Koreans Act, such as guaranteeing the rights and interests of overseas compatriots, reducing additional management costs by preventing vacancies, addressing population decline, and revitalizing the local economy. <<> Accordingly, the BAI presented its opinion to South Chungcheong Province, stating that "foreign-national compatriots can be selected as occupants for unsold units on a first-come, first-served basis based on application order." The BAI added, "Through this, the Chungcheongnam-do Development Corporation is expected to secure operational revenue of 163 million won in rental deposits per unit and monthly rent of 180,000 won, and contribute to economic revitalization through population inflow to the local community." (감사원이 신축 공공 임대 주택에서 미분양 세대가 생겼다면 외국 국적 동포에게 우선 공급할 수 있다는 해석을 내놨다.)

item.title: The ‘Three-Time Spokesman’ Voice of U.S. Diplomacy: “South Korea Cannot Be Fully Described with the Word ‘Ally’” (‘대변인 3관왕’ 美외교의 입… “한국, 동맹이란 말로는 다 표현 못 해”)
item.description:
The ‘Three-Time Spokesman’ Voice of U.S. Diplomacy: “South Korea Cannot Be Fully Described with the Word ‘Ally’” (‘대변인 3관왕’ 美외교의 입… “한국, 동맹이란 말로는 다 표현 못 해”)

Ned Price, former U.S. State Department spokesperson, met with this publication on the 16th at the Aspen Security Forum (ASF) held in Aspen, Colorado, and stated, “I think the term ‘alliance’ simply fails to fully capture what South Korea means to the United States and its significance,” adding, “I oppose exaggerating South Korea as a ‘net recipient’ that only receives and never gives back. Beyond security, South Korea is a critically important economic partner, and its immense investment in the U.S. has become another tie binding the U.S.-ROK relationship.” He acknowledged that “unfortunately, the relationship faces artificial headwinds” due to the Trump administration’s tariffs and pressure on defense cost-sharing, but emphasized that “the decades-long U.S.-ROK alliance will continue.” (네드 프라이스 전 미 국무부 대변인은 지난 16일 콜로라도주(州) 애스펀에서 열린 애스펀안보포럼(ASF) 현장에서 본지와 만나 “단순히 ‘동맹(alliance)’이란 말로는 한국이 미국에 어떤 존재이고, 어떤 의미를 지니는지 제대로 표현하지 못한다고 생각한다”며 “한국을 받기만 하고 돌려주지 않는 ‘순수 수혜자(net recipient)’로 과장해 묘사하는 것에 반대한다. 안보 그 이상으로 매우 중요한 경제 파트너로 미국에 대한 막대한 투자가 한미 관계에 또 다른 유대(tie)가 되고 있다”고 했다. 그는 트럼프 정부의 관세 부과, 방위 부담 분담 압박 등으로 “안타깝게도 인위적인 역풍에 직면해 있다”면서도 “수십 년 지속된 한미동맹은 계속될 것”이라고 했다.)

Price served as the ‘voice’ explaining U.S. diplomacy to the public as State Department spokesperson under the Biden administration. Prior to that, he served as a spokesperson for the White House National Security Council (NSC) and the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) under the Obama administration, holding the spokesperson role a total of three times. Price said, “Unlike domestic issues, which are deeply politicized, foreign policy and national security matters are largely apolitical and revolve around U.S. national interests and values,” adding, “Because I have a strong belief in the values the U.S. has championed and their foundation, being able to convey those to the media was truly enjoyable and rewarding.” He noted that officials in foreign affairs and security agencies, which handle sensitive information, tend to be reluctant to share information with the media, and “grappling with the appropriate way to deliver that information was both part of the role and a challenge.” Price currently serves as the co-interim director of the Harvard Institute of Politics. (프라이스는 조 바이든 정부에서 국무부 대변인으로 있으면서 미국 외교를 대중에 설명하는 ‘입’ 역할을 했다. 이보다 앞서 버락 오바마 정부에선 백악관 국가안보회의(NSC), 중앙정보국(CIA)에서 대변인을 지냈다. 대변인만 무려 세 차례 역임한 것인데, 프라이스는 “정치가 깊이 스며드는 국내 문제와 달리 외교·안보 현안은 정치와 무관하고 미국의 국익, 가치에 관한 일이 주를 이룬다”며 “미국이 옹호해 온 가치와 그 기반에 대해 강한 믿음을 갖고 있기 때문에 이를 언론에 전달할 수 있는 건 정말 즐겁고 보람 있는 일이었다”고 했다. 외교·안보 부처 특성상 기밀을 주로 다루는 당국자들이 언론에 정보 공유를 꺼리는 경향이 강한데 “적절한 전달 방식을 고민하는 것이 역할의 일부이자 도전 과제였다”고 했다. 프라이스는 현재 하버드대 정치연구소 공동 임시 국장으로 있다.)

The State Department, the heart of U.S. diplomacy, is involved in issues around the globe, and its spokesperson briefings draw a wide range of questions from the international media. Price said, “While I may have lacked deep knowledge on some topics, I definitely had the opportunity to learn and grasp the content through close conversations with experts within the State Department on the major issues of the day.” He cited the U.S. withdrawal from Afghanistan and Russia’s invasion of Ukraine as the most difficult and memorable moments. He remarked, “In foreign policy and national security, the world never stands still,” and “It was a time when on-the-ground information and facts were changing very rapidly, minute by minute, making it challenging to explain our policies.” Price, who received countless questions about North Korea’s nuclear program and missiles during his tenure, stated, “The U.S. government continues to pursue denuclearization policy, and political and economic pressure will follow,” adding, “We hope for principled diplomacy, but I do not expect (dialogue) to occur this year or within this administration’s term.” (미 외교의 심장인 국무부는 전 세계 모든 문제에 관여하며, 대변인 브리핑에선 세계 각국의 언론으로부터 다양한 질문이 쏟아진다. 프라이스는 “깊이 있는 지식은 부족했을지 몰라도 그날의 주요 현안에 대해 국무부 내 전문가들과 면밀한 대화를 통해 내용을 배우고 파악할 기회가 분명히 있었다”고 했다. 가장 힘들면서도 기억에 남는 순간으로는 아프가니스탄의 미군 철수, 러시아의 우크라이나 침공을 꼽았다. 그는 “외교·안보 분야에선 세상이 결코 멈춰서 있지 않는다”며 “현장의 정보, 사실이 분(分) 단위로 매우 빠르게 변하던 시기라 우리의 정책을 설명하는 일이 어려웠다”고 했다. 재임 중 북한 핵·미사일에 관한 질문도 수없이 받았던 프라이스는 “미국 정부는 계속해서 비핵화 정책을 추구하고, 정치·경제 압박도 따를 것”이라며 “원칙에 입각한 외교를 희망하지만 올해나 이번 정부 임기 중 (대화가) 이뤄질 것으로 기대하지는 않는다”고 했다.)

Recalling his time at the State Department, Price said, “My Korean counterparts there were always ready to dive into any challenge, possessing a passion that constantly asked, ‘What more can we do together?’” He added, “Because the U.S.-ROK alliance is based on shared interests and values, I have no doubt that it will endure across administrations.” He fondly remembered South Korea, which he visited on business, as “the place where I received the warmest welcome of anywhere I’ve been.” Former Secretary of State Antony Blinken, whom Price served as spokesperson and senior advisor, made headlines in February this year for a surprise rock band performance at the Chey Institute event in Washington, D.C. Price commented, “Since diplomacy deals with subtle agreements and difficult negotiations, it’s a very good thing for diplomats to show their human side whenever the opportunity arises.” (프라이스는 “내가 국무부에 있으면서 경험한 한국 측 카운터 파트는 어떤 과제 앞에도 뛰어들 준비가 돼 있었고, 항상 ‘우리가 함께 더 무엇을 할 수 있을까’라고 말하는 열정을 갖고 있었다”며 “한미는 공동의 이익, 가치에 기반을 두고 있기 때문에 동맹이 정부를 거치면서도 지속될 것을 의심하지 않는다”고 했다. 출장차 방문한 한국을 “내가 가본 곳 중 가장 따뜻한 환대를 받았던 곳”이라고 기억했다. 프라이스가 대변인, 선임 고문으로 모신 ‘상사’인 토니 블링컨 전 국무장관은 올해 2월 워싱턴 DC에서 열린 최종현학술원 행사에서 깜짝 록밴드 공연을 선보인 것이 큰 화제가 됐다. 프라이스는 “외교는 미묘한 합의, 어려운 협상을 다루는 일이기 때문에 외교관들이 기회가 될 때마다 인간적인 면모를 보여주는 건 아주 좋은 일”이라고 했다.)

item.title: US Conservative Think Tank Proposes "South Korea and US Should Cooperate to Counter China's Malign Influence" (美보수 싱크탱크 “한미, 中의 악의적 영향력 맞서 협력해야” 제안)
item.description:
US Conservative Think Tank Proposes "South Korea and US Should Cooperate to Counter China's Malign Influence" (美보수 싱크탱크 “한미, 中의 악의적 영향력 맞서 협력해야” 제안)

Derek Morgan, Senior Vice President of the Heritage Foundation, a conservative think tank in Washington, DC, and researcher Anthony Kim, in a recently published report, stated that "despite internal and external pressures, the South Korea-US alliance remains strong and resilient," proposing that the two countries cooperate to counter China's "malign influence." According to a report attached to the Fiscal Year 2027 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) released by the Senate last month, it explicitly requires an investigation into the "malign influence of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP)" that has penetrated South Korea's infrastructure and society at large, to be submitted to Congress. Although there are still several steps before the bill is finally passed, it reflects the awareness of the issue across the US political spectrum. (미국 워싱턴 DC의 보수 성향 싱크탱크인 헤리티지재단의 데릭 모건 수석부회장·앤서니 김 연구원은 최근 발간한 보고서에서 “내·외부 압력에도 불구하고 한미 동맹은 여전히 강력하고 탄력적”이라며 한미가 중국의 ‘악의적 영향력(malign influence)’에 대응하기 위해 협력할 것을 제안했다. 상원이 지난달 공개한 2027 회계연도 국방수권법안(NDAA) 부속 보고서를 보면 처음으로 한국 인프라와 사회 전반에 침투한 ‘중국 공산당(CCP)의 악의적 영향력’을 조사해 의회에 제출할 것을 명시하고 있다. 법안이 최종 통과되기까지 여러 절차가 남았지만, 미 조야(朝野)의 문제의식을 반영하고 있는 것이다.)

The report acknowledges that "in an era when all US relationships are being examined through the lens of 'America First,' it is natural for even long-standing alliances to be uneasy," but also notes that "South Korea and the US have a foundation rooted in shared values, national security goals, and cutting-edge business cooperation," adding that "they can do much more together beyond security cooperation." It continues, "Now is the time for President Donald Trump, who has cultivated a spirit of practical partnership, and President Lee Jae-myung to confront emerging issues head-on, address geopolitical challenges, and invest in mutually beneficial economic development projects to further solidify the alliance," stating that "these joint actions will lead the time-tested alliance toward a future of greater freedom, opportunity, and prosperity." (보고서는 “미국의 모든 관계가 ‘미국 우선주의’라는 렌즈를 통해 검토되고 있는 시대에 오랜 동맹조차 불안해하는 것은 당연한 일”이라면서도 “한미가 공유된 가치, 국가 안보에 대한 목표, 최첨단 비즈니스 협력 등에 뿌리를 둔 기반을 갖추고 있다”며 “안보 협력을 훨씬 뛰어넘는 분야에서 함께 더 많은 일을 할 수 있다”고 했다. 이어 “실용적인 파트너십 정신을 키워온 도널드 트럼프 대통령과 이재명 대통령이 새로운 현안에 정면으로 맞서고, 지정학적인 과제를 해결하며, 상호 이익이 되는 경제 발전 프로젝트에 투자해 동맹을 한층 더 공고히 할 때”라며 “이런 공동 조치가 오랜 시간 검증된 동맹을 더 큰 자유, 기회, 번영의 미래로 이끌 것”이라고 했다.)

The report identifies shipbuilding and defense, energy production, and nuclear power including small modular reactors (SMRs) as areas where South Korea and the US can deepen cooperation to strengthen their foundation as a military-strategic alliance and elevate it to the next level. However, it also notes that "the economic system remains constrained by regulatory barriers that limit entrepreneurial opportunities," indicating that it is "time to address the more difficult issues that prevent South Korea from truly transforming into a dynamic economy." This reflects the concern among US political circles that the South Korean government is discriminating against American companies operating in the country. Michelle Steel, the incoming US ambassador to South Korea, also expressed this concern during her confirmation hearing last May, stating that "American companies doing business in South Korea deserve the same market access that South Korean companies enjoy in the United States." Notably, the "Coupang incident" stemming from a personal information leak last year has been a bilateral obstacle for over six months. (보고서는 한미가 군사·전략 동맹으로서 기반을 다지고, 동맹을 새로운 차원으로 한 단계 더 발전시키기 위해 협력을 심화할 수 있는 분야로 조선과 방산, 에너지 생산, 소형모듈원자로(SMR)를 비롯한 원자력 발전 등을 꼽았다. 그러면서도 “경제 시스템이 여전히 기업가적 기회를 제한하는 규제 장벽에 얽매여 있다”며 “한국이 진정으로 역동적인 경제로 거듭나는 것을 가로막는 더 어려운 문제들을 해결할 때”라고 했다. 이는 우리 정부가 국내에서 사업을 영위하는 미국 기업을 상대로 ‘차별’을 하고 있다는 미 조야의 문제의식이 투영된 대목이다. 부임이 임박한 미셸 스틸 주한 미국 대사도 지난 5월 청문회에서 “한국에서 사업을 영위하는 미국 기업들은 한국 기업들이 미국에서 누리는 것과 동일한 시장 접근권을 누릴 자격이 있다”며 문제의식을 드러냈다. 특히 지난해 개인 정보 유출 사태로 불거진 ‘쿠팡 사태’는 반년 넘게 양자(兩者) 관계의 장애물로 작용하고 있다.)

item.title: At a Policy Debate, "Return of Wartime Operational Control Could Accelerate US Departure from the Korean Peninsula" (野토론회서 “전작권 환수, 美 한반도 이탈 가속화할 것”)
item.description:
At a Policy Debate, "Return of Wartime Operational Control Could Accelerate US Departure from the Korean Peninsula" (野토론회서 “전작권 환수, 美 한반도 이탈 가속화할 것”)

Concerns have been raised that the push by the Lee Jae-myung administration to regain wartime operational control (OPCON), potentially as early as 2027, could accelerate the withdrawal of US forces from the Korean Peninsula. (이재명 정부가 이르면 2027년을 목표로 추진하고 있는 전시작전통제권 환수가 미군의 한반도 이탈을 가속화할 수 있다는 지적이 나왔다.)

People Power Party lawmaker Kang Sun-young and the North Korea Nuclear Response Research Group of the Foundation for the Advancement of the Korean Peninsula held a forum on the morning of the 22nd at the second sub-committee room of the National Assembly Members' Office Building, titled "Is the Return of Wartime OPCON Equaling the Dissolution of the Current ROK-US Combined Forces Command a Matter to Be Rushed?" (강선영 국민의힘 의원과 한반도선진화재단 북핵대응연구회는 22일 오전 국회의원회관 제2소회의실에서 ‘전작권 환수=현(現) 한미연합사 해체, 서두를 일인가?’라는 포럼을 개최했다.)

Tae-Hwa Hong, an Asia Fellow at the Foreign Policy Research Institute (FPRI) in the US, who presented that day, stated, "If South Korea rushes to take back wartime OPCON and formally blocks strategic flexibility, both pillars of deterring North Korea and checking China could weaken, potentially opening the door to a reduction or withdrawal of US Forces Korea." Fellow Hong elaborated, "From the US perspective, the reason for the existence of US Forces Korea is to deter North Korea and check China. If South Korea hastily takes back OPCON, the justification for (US Forces Korea's) deterrence of North Korea becomes blurred. If the South Korean government also explicitly denies US strategic flexibility, the function of US Forces Korea in checking China is also blocked." This suggests that at a time when the US is shifting its center of gravity toward containing China and seeking to step back from the Korean Peninsula, the return of wartime OPCON could accelerate the trend of US departure from the peninsula. Fellow Hong added, "The integrated combined command (through the ROK-US Combined Forces Command) was the bond that, to some extent, kept the US tied to the Korean Peninsula. A hasty return could be us breaking that bond with our own hands." (이날 발제자로 나선 홍태화 미국 외교정책연구소(FPRI) 아시아 펠로는 “한국이 전작권을 서둘러 가져가고 전략적 유연성을 공식적으로 차단하면, 북한 억제·중국 견제 두 축 모두가 약해지면서 주한미군 감축·철수의 길목이 열릴 수 있다”고 했다. 홍 펠로는 “미국 관점에서 주한미군의 존재 이유는 북한 억제와 대중국 견제”라며 “한국이 전작권을 서둘러 가져오면 (주한미군의) 북한 억제라는 명분이 흐려지고, 한국 정부가 미국의 전략적 유연성마저 명시적으로 거부하면 주한미군의 대중국 견제 기능 또한 막힌다”고 했다. 미국이 중국 견제로 무게중심을 옮기고 한반도에서 발을 빼려는 상황에서 전작권 환수가 미국의 한반도 이탈 흐름을 가속화할 수 있다는 것이다. 홍 펠로는 “(한미연합사를 통한) 통합된 연합 지휘는 미국을 그나마 한반도 묶어 두던 결속의 끈이었는데, 조급한 환수는 그 끈을 우리 손으로 끊어내는 일이 될 수 있다”고 했다.)

Hui-Rak Park, Chairman of the North Korea Nuclear Response Research Group of the Foundation for the Advancement of the Korean Peninsula, who presented on "Misunderstandings and Arrogance Surrounding the Return of Wartime OPCON," stated, "With the dual command and control design of a Korean commander-US deputy commander system and the Military Committee Meeting not yet sufficiently mature or verified, accelerating the timeline is a dangerous experiment." Chairman Park particularly diagnosed, "Some political circles and public opinion are mired in the image of 'self-reliant defense,' displaying a cognitive bias that minimizes and distorts complex security risks." (‘전작권 환수를 둘러싼 오해와 오만’ 발제를 맡은 박휘락 한반도선진화재단 북핵대응연구회 회장은 “한국군 사령관-미군 부사령관 체제와 군사협의위원회를 통한 이원적 지휘·통제 설계가 충분히 성숙·검증되지 않은 상태에서 시간표만 앞당기는 것은 위험한 실험”이라고 했다. 특히 박 회장은 “일부 정치권과 여론이 ‘자주국방’ 이미지에 매몰돼 복합 안보위험을 축소·왜곡하는 인지적 편향을 보이고 있다”고 진단했다.)

Jae-kyu Jang, a professor of military science at Yeungnam University, addressed the topic "The Alliance Politics Context of Returning Wartime OPCON and Challenges for Combined Defense," pointing out that changes to the wartime OPCON structure inevitably accompany adjustments to the role of US Forces Korea and a redesign of the ROK-US alliance. Professor Jang expressed concern, stating, "The dissolution or transformation of the ROK-US Combined Forces Command is not a simple organizational restructuring but a process of rewriting the alliance's 'political contract'—including the role and mission of US Forces Korea, the C4I (Command, Control, Communications, Computers, and Intelligence) system, transitioning DEFCON during crises, and the operation of joint delegated command authority. If a speed-focused approach is taken without sufficient strategic dialogue and domestic political consensus, it could create cracks in alliance trust and crisis management mechanisms." (장재규 영남대 군사학과 교수는 ‘전작권 환수의 동맹 정치 맥락과 연합방위의 과제’를 주제로 전작권 구조 변화가 주한미군 역할 조정과 한미동맹 재설계를 동반할 수밖에 없다는 점을 짚었다. 장 교수는 “한미연합사 해체 혹은 변형은 단순 조직 개편이 아니라, 주한미군 역할·임무, C4I(지휘·통제·통신·컴퓨터·정보) 체계, 위기 시 데프콘 전환과 공동위임지휘권 운용 등 동맹의 ‘정치적 계약’을 다시 쓰는 과정”이라며 “충분한 전략 대화와 국내 정치적 합의 없이 속도전을 벌일 경우 동맹 신뢰와 위기관리 메커니즘에 균열이 생길 수 있다”고 우려했다.)

In her opening remarks, lawmaker Kang Sun-young, who hosted the forum that day, said, "Discussions on wartime OPCON are matters that require not only the government, military, and alliance partners but also the National Assembly and the public to share sufficient information, debate, and deliberate on them." She added, "With North Korea, China, and Russia accelerating military modernization, and Kim Jong-un strengthening aggressive foreign strategies through troop dispatches to Russia's war, attending Victory Day events with Putin, and holding summit meetings with Xi Jinping, it cannot be said that conditions for the return of wartime OPCON have improved in any respect." (이날 토론회를 주최한 강선영 의원은 모두발언에서 “전작권 논의는 정부·군·동맹 파트너뿐 아니라 국회와 국민이 충분한 정보를 공유해 토론하고 숙고해야 할 사안”이라며 “북·중·러가 군사 현대화에 박차를 가하고 김정은이 러시아 전쟁 파병·푸틴과 전승절 행사 참석·시진핑과 정상회담 등으로 공격적인 대외 전략을 강화하는 상황에서, 어느 측면에서도 전작권 환수 조건이 호전됐다고 볼 수 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: Presidential Office: "President Lee Delayed Apartment Sale Balance Payment and Did Not Charge Interest" (靑 “李대통령, 아파트 매각 잔금 유예하며 이자 안 받아”)
item.description:
Presidential Office: "President Lee Delayed Apartment Sale Balance Payment and Did Not Charge Interest" (靑 “李대통령, 아파트 매각 잔금 유예하며 이자 안 받아”)

It has been confirmed that President Lee Jae-myung and his wife, during the process of selling their apartment in Yangji Village, Bundang-gu, Seongnam-si, Gyeonggi Province, for 2.9 billion won, transferred ownership to the buyer first, delayed the payment of a large balance for several months, and also provided an 'interest-free' benefit. The Presidential Office explained this as goodwill toward the buyer, but large interest-free transactions between private individuals could be subject to gift tax evasion. The Presidential Office stated, "If the buyer has to pay gift tax, they will bear it." <<> On the morning of the 22nd, the Presidential Office addressed suspicions regarding the sale of President Lee's home through its official YouTube channel's own program, 'Fact Mill.' The transaction was finalized at a total of 2.9 billion won, and President Lee's side transferred ownership to the buyer in advance on the condition of receiving the balance at the end of October. Instead, a collateral mortgage of 1.77 billion won was set up in case of non-payment of the balance. <<> Deputy spokesperson Ahn Gwi-ryeong, who hosted the program that day, explained the method of President Lee's apartment sale, saying, "Let's point out one more thing: typically, if the balance payment is deferred for several months, given the large amount, the interest alone would be substantial, but it has been confirmed that they agreed not to charge interest." Professor Han Moon-do from Yonsei University, who also appeared on the show, said, "It seems the President considered the buyer," adding, "Of course, one might ask why no interest is charged, but considering the gap is only 3-4 months, they decided not to charge interest." <<> The Presidential Office explained this as a positive story about the President and a gesture of goodwill toward the buyer, but it is problematic. This is because, when a large sum of money is transacted between private individuals or the balance is deferred without interest, tax issues may arise under the Inheritance Tax and Gift Tax Act. <<> Current tax law considers the interest difference as 'gifted' if money is borrowed from another person for free or at an interest rate lower than the appropriate rate. However, for loans between family members who are specially related individuals under tax law, gift tax is not imposed if the interest benefit from the interest-free loan is less than 10 million won annually. President Lee and his wife are not related to the buyer. <<> Earlier, in May, the National Tax Service announced plans for tax audits on suspected real estate tax evaders, listing 'cash-rich individuals not subject to loan regulations and individuals with excessive private debt' as the first type of audit targets. Examples included cases where individuals borrowed large sums from parents or others due to loan regulations making it difficult to get financial institution loans, or obtained funds from specially related individuals to purchase homes. They emphasized at the time that they would strictly verify whether the debt was actually borrowed and whether interest was paid. <<> In that day's broadcast, the reason for transferring ownership first and setting up a collateral mortgage was introduced. Yangji Village in Bundang, where the apartment is located, has been designated as a leading reconstruction zone for first-generation new towns. Professor Han said, "Reconstruction here is progressing through a trust company model. If a property is purchased after the date the local government designates and announces the trust company as the project implementer, the buyer cannot receive the 'membership rights' and becomes subject to cash settlement (so-called 'water ticket')." <<> Given that the designation announcement was expected around August, if the buyer paid the balance and took over ownership in October, they would lose the right to move into the new apartment. To remedy this, President Lee transferred the registration early. <<> Regarding suspicions of 'gap investment,' Professor Han said, "This area is a land transaction permit zone, so the buyer must undergo a local government's actual residency review. If they do not move in within six months after paying the balance, they must pay an enforcement fine (penalty) amounting to 10% of the apartment price annually, making gap investment fundamentally impossible." <<> The Presidential Office stated, "As a long-term resident of a single-home household, President Lee could have maintained his reconstruction membership status and achieved greater market profits without rushing to sell. Nevertheless, he sold his home and became a homeless person, demonstrating through leading by example the President's firm will to vigorously promote real estate policies going forward." <<> Regarding the gift tax issue, they said, "If the buyer has to pay gift tax, they will bear it." (이재명 대통령 부부가 경기 성남시 분당구 양지마을 아파트를 29억원에 매각하는 과정에서 매수자에게 소유권을 먼저 넘겨주고 거액의 잔금 지급을 수개월 유예해 주는 동시에 ‘무이자’ 혜택까지 제공한 것으로 확인됐다. 청와대는 매수자를 위한 선의라고 설명했지만, 사인 간의 거액 무이자 거래는 증여세 탈세 소지가 있다. 청와대는 “만약 매수자가 증여세를 내야 한다면 부담할 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: South Korea Detains Ship "Prada" Accused of Violating UN North Korea Sanctions (정부 “안보리 대북제재 위반한 선박 ‘프라다호’ 억류 중”)
item.description:
South Korea Detains Ship "Prada" Accused of Violating UN North Korea Sanctions (정부 “안보리 대북제재 위반한 선박 ‘프라다호’ 억류 중”)

The South Korean government has detained a ship that violated United Nations Security Council resolutions by transporting coal from a North Korean port. (북한 항구에서 선탄을 운반해 유엔 안전보장이사회의 대북 제재 결의를 위반한 선박을 한국 정부가 억류하고 있는 것으로 나타났다.)

According to diplomatic authorities on the 22nd, the government confirmed suspicions that the ship named PRADA, which entered Pyeongtaek Port in March, had violated North Korea sanctions. (22일 외교 당국에 따르면, 정부는 지난 3월 평택항으로 들어온 프라다(PRADA)호라는 선박의 대북 제재 위반 혐의를 확인했다.)

A foreign ministry official stated, "Based on information that the PRADA had been involved in activities violating past UN Security Council resolutions on North Korea, the government conducted a joint investigation by relevant agencies upon its entry into Pyeongtaek Port." (외교부 당국자는 “정부는 프라다호가 과거 안보리 대북 제재 결의 위반 활동에 관여했다는 정보를 바탕으로, 평택항에 입항한 동 선박에 대해 관계 부처 합동 조사를 진행했다”고 했다.)

He added, "The government investigation confirmed the PRADA’s involvement in violations of Security Council resolutions, and as a follow-up measure under the resolutions, the ship is currently being detained." The PRADA had been suspected of loading coal at a North Korean port, and authorities reportedly confirmed this to be true. (이어 “정부 조사 결과 프라다호의 안보리 결의 위반 가담 사실이 밝혀져 안보리 결의에 따른 후속 조치로서 동 선박을 억류 중”이라고 했다. 프라다호는 북한 항구에서 석탄을 선적했다는 의혹을 받았는데, 당국은 이것이 사실임을 확인한 것으로 알려졌다.)

Earlier, in May of last year, the private analysis agency Open Source Center (OSC) released satellite images showing the PRADA, operating under the name "Sophia," loading coal at North Korea's Nampo Port in September and December 2024. (앞서 작년 5월 민간 분석 기관 오픈소스센터(OSC)는 프라다호가 ‘소피아’라는 이름으로 운항하던 2024년 9월과 12월 북한 남포항에서 석탄을 선적하는 장면이 담긴 위성사진을 공개한 바 있다.)

The ship was also cited as having violated North Korea sanctions in a joint statement issued in May by South Korea, the United States, Japan, the European Union (EU), the United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, and New Zealand, urging the implementation of sanctions against North Korea. (이 선박은 지난 5월 한국·미국·일본과 유럽연합(EU)·영국·호주·캐나다·뉴질랜드 등이 발표한 대북 제재 이행 촉구 공동 성명에서 대북 제재를 위반한 것으로 언급되기도 했다.)

item.title: Cardinal Yu Heung-sik: "The Holy Father Can Do Great Things in Inter-Korean Relations" (유흥식 추기경 “교황님, 남북관계에 큰 일 하실 수 있어”)
item.description:
Cardinal Yu Heung-sik: "The Holy Father Can Do Great Things in Inter-Korean Relations" (유흥식 추기경 “교황님, 남북관계에 큰 일 하실 수 있어”)

Cardinal Yu Heung-sik (75), Prefect of the Dicastery for the Clergy, said on the 22nd, "It seems the Holy Father could do great things in inter-Korean relations," adding, "The Holy See is doing all it can (in its capacity)." (교황청 성직자부 장관 유흥식(75) 추기경은 22일 “교황님은 남북관계에 큰 일 하실수 있을 것 같다”며 “교황청으로서는 (할 수 있는) 모든 역할을 한다”고 했다.)

Cardinal Yu made these remarks in response to comments from Unification Minister Kim Young-ho during their meeting, where the minister expressed hope for the Holy See's role in creating a breakthrough in inter-Korean relations. (유 추기경은 이날 정동영 통일부 장관과 만난 자리에서 남북관계 돌파구 마련을 위한 교황청의 역할을 희망하는 정 장관 발언에 대해 이렇게 말했다.)

Minister Kim said that day, "I expect the Pope's visit to Korea next year will be a tremendous blessing for peace on the Korean Peninsula," and "The Korean Peninsula has been cut off from all contact, dialogue, and meetings with North Korea for the past seven or eight years. I hope the Pope's visit will serve as an opportunity to build that bridge." (정 장관은 이날 “내년에 교황님이 한국에 오시는 것이 한반도 평화의 아주 큰 축복이 될 것이라고 기대한다”며 “한반도는 지금 지난 7, 8년 동안 북한과의 일체 접촉, 대화, 만남이 끊어져 있는 상황인데 교황님께서 오심으로서 그 다리를 놓는 계기가 되길 기대한다”고 했다.)

In response, Cardinal Yu stated, "I proposed to Pope Francis several years ago that this World Youth Day be held in Korea," and "After months of preparation, we eventually succeeded in hosting this World Youth Day. So I, too, feel a sense of responsibility." He added, "Reflecting on the spirit of martyrdom and having young people gather in Korea to practice peace and harmony together would be immensely meaningful." (이에 유 추기경은 “몇 년 전 프란치스코 교황께 이번 세계청년대회를 한국에서 하자고 제안한 바 있다”며 “몇 달 동안 사전 준비를 거쳐 결국 이번 세계청년대회 유치가 이루어졌다. 그래서 저 역시 한편으로는 책임감을 느끼고 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “순교 정신을 되새기고, 젊은이들이 함께 평화와 화합을 실천하며 한국에 모인다면 엄청난 의미가 있을 것”이라고 했다.)

Pope Leo XIV is scheduled to visit Korea to attend the '2027 Seoul World Youth Day (WYD)' in August next year. If Pope Leo XIV visits Korea, it will be his first visit to the country and the fourth papal visit in history. Seoul World Youth Day is the world's largest Catholic youth event organized by the Holy See, and it will be the second such event held in Asia. (레오 14세 교황은 내년 8월 열리는 ‘2027 서울 세계청년대회(WYD)’ 참석을 위해 한국을 방문할 예정이다. 레오 14세 교황 방한이 이뤄지면 그의 첫 방한이자, 역대 네 번째 교황의 방한이 된다. 서울 세계청년대회는 교황청이 주관하는 세계 최대 규모의 가톨릭 청년 행사로, 아시아에서 역대 두 번째로 열리는 대회다.)

Minister Kim said, "Apart from political implications, I hope that young people from the North can also participate when youth from around the world gather." He continued, "Before the Pope visits next year, we will work hard to restore trust between the two Koreas and help ensure the World Youth Day is a great success in a positive atmosphere." In response, Cardinal Yu stated, "The Pope's schedule and messages are immediately shared with all apostolic nunciatures worldwide, and the nuncios in each country can play a role by contacting the North Korean side according to local circumstances," adding, "He will be visiting from August 3rd to 8th next year, and we see such a role and are working towards it." (정 장관은 “정치적인 의미를 떠나서 세계 청소년들이 모이는데 북쪽의 청소년들도 함께 참석할 수 있기를 소망한다”고 했다. 이어 “내년에 교황님이 오시기 전까지 저희가 열심히 다시 남북 간의 신뢰 회복을 위해서 노력하고 좋은 분위기 속에서 세계 청년대회가 아주 성공적으로 되도록 잘 돕겠다”고 했다. 이에 유 추기경은 “교황의 일정과 메시지는 전 세계 교황청 대사관에 즉시 공유되고, 각국 교황대사들이 현지 상황에 맞게 북한 측과 접촉하는 등 역할을 할 수 있다”며 “(교황이) 내년 8월 3일부터 8일까지 방문하시는 데 그런 역할이 있다고 보고 노력하고 있다”고 했다.)
